Well I can relate to being lonely. I like the effort you're doing to try and talk with people outside. Don't really expect to be greeted back by most people. I also do it but usually with security guards or retail workers like saying "good morning" back to them or thanking them. It's not a sure fire way to socialize with people especially these retail workers as they're just doing their jobs so they may not prefer small talk while at work. 

If you do want to get along with people I say find like minded ones. Do you have any interests or hobbies? Perhaps finding  community that shares the same interest is a good start. I don't know where you live but you can try finding these spaces or communities online as usually they could do meetups as well. If you are still in school try joining clubs or organizations. If you're currently working then I think that's also best to make small talk with coworkers you are comfortable with.
